title: Admissions Notice For UCW 2023
text:
Admissions-2023, University College For Women, AWKUM

CALL FOR ADMISSIONS FALL 2023

Online applications are invited for admission to
FSc/FA

(Pre-Medical,

Pre-Engineering,

Humanities)
and Associate Degree Programs
at University College for Women, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
,
Main Campus College Chowk Mardan.
Applications can be submitted online at
http://admissions.awkum.edu.pk/. (http://admissions.awkum.edu.pk/)
University College for Women (UCW) is a constituent college of Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM), which is ranked 1st in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, 5th in Pakistan, and 149th in Asia according to the recently released Times Higher Education University Rankings for 2023. AWKUM has consistently held top positions in various national rankings, reflecting its commitment to academic excellence. UCW aims to provide a safe, accessible, and affordable learning environment for females in the region. UCW graduates have successfully pursued prestigious professions, including medicine, academia, telecommunications, and civil aviation. Last year, more than 50% of UCW students secured A1/A grades in their HSSC examinations.

SALIENT FEATURES

Pick and drop facility
On-campus hostel for female students
State of the art infrastructure
The best Learning Management System (LMS)
Well-equipped laboratories, libraries, sports grounds and conducive educationalenvironment

Internet/Wi-Fi
Qualified faculty(MS/PhD)
